recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not restore the R5 linkage elements for FHIR-39094. If BRR wants a new direct linkage between a ResearchSubject comparisonGroup and a ResearchStudy comparisonGroup backbone row, that should be raised as a new R6 issue.
issue_request: FHIR-39094 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5 ResearchStudy. It requested clearer linkage between ResearchStudy.comparisonGroup and ResearchSubject by renaming ResearchSubject.assignedArm/actualArm to assignedComparisonGroup/actualComparisonGroup, making those and the ResearchStudy comparison-group linkage id-typed, replacing the ResearchStudy comparisonGroup identifier with an id, and adding explanatory examples through FHIR-39370.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by f41665322e16e96793c7267bc630cb679b614ddc, with follow-up commits 1e9c3f475cfd7f51d896c95659a2fe46f95f8005 and e0bbd68448764e0d54463d56c17fdcf5e7f48abb changing the ResearchStudy linkage child to linkId for validator compatibility. FHIR-39370 was implemented by 92569721347e01f38e70e6dc7cef31f23c7c0915 with a ResearchSubject example.
additional_context: Later applied R6 issues intentionally changed the model. FHIR-48736 refactored ResearchStudy.comparisonGroup around targetNumber, actualNumber, eligibility, and observedGroup Group references and removed the old linkId. FHIR-49963 replaced stale comparisonGroup.id guidance with contained Group/id reference guidance. FHIR-53229 replaced ResearchSubject.assignedComparisonGroup and actualComparisonGroup with ResearchSubject.comparisonGroup 0..* CodeableReference as part of normative-track preparation. FHIR-53693 later added ResearchStudy.comparisonGroup.name as a simple label.
reconciliation: The current source is internally consistent with those later final decisions: ResearchStudy.comparisonGroup.eligibility and observedGroup reference Group, ResearchStudy.objective.outcomeMeasure intervention/comparator comments explain reusing a contained Group by Group.id, and ResearchSubject.comparisonGroup is a CodeableReference to Group or an example-coded concept. Restoring FHIR-39094's exact R5 id/linkId and assigned/actualComparisonGroup elements would contradict later applied BRR decisions.
